title: XUSD reserve attestation history is published from February 2024
description: The current StraitsX XUSD product page publishes a reserve-attestation series beginning with a 29 February 2024 report and later continuing on a monthly cadence.
notes: This is the earliest dated official XUSD checkpoint in the reviewed source set; it is not asserted as the exact first mint or launch date.

title: Blast mainnet introduces native USDB
description: Blast mainnet made USDB available as its native auto-rebasing stablecoin, with stablecoin bridge deposits represented as USDB and bridge-back redemption described in DAI.
notes: The event records protocol launch context and does not establish a direct fiat issuer claim.
